description: Invented, manually labeled saved memories. Routine list entries precede the labeled facts. No extraction model is evaluated.

bullets.text: Mara named her little boat Last Light after her brother's final signal.
Mara told Ari the password was violet lantern, then asked him to keep it secret.

Mara suspected that the brass key was inside a blue teapot.
  She had not checked the teapot, so this location was unconfirmed.
Ari gave Mara a pocket watch engraved 08:17. It belonged to his mother.
Ari left the western gate unlocked so Bea could enter before dawn.
Ari returned the copper ring to Bea on February 16, 2027.
Bea hid the folded map beneath the bakery's loose floorboard.
Bea's exact promise was: "I will come back before the bells."
Nell treated Ari's sprained wrist with a blue cloth.
Bea's warning concerned crimson glass at the old laboratory.

qualifier.text: The warning remained unverified and subject to the laboratory inspection.

bullets.text: The old observatory's vault code is 7349.
